_comment: What runs on a HeliOS router. Core services always run. Switchable services can be turned on/off in Photosphere (Advanced → Services); state.json "services" overrides the site.nix default. Turning one on downloads its software at the next apply; turning it off removes it at the next apply.

core.label: Firewall
core.desc: Heliopause: isolation between networks, the trap, DNS enforcement.

core.label: DNS and filtering
core.desc: AdGuard Home answers every network's DNS and applies the filtering profiles.

core.label: Time (NTP)
core.desc: chrony keeps the router and your devices on time.

core.label: Management
core.desc: This interface (Cockpit), SSH, config backups and change history.

core.label: Health checks
core.desc: Outage monitor, hardware watchdog, hardware detection, traffic stats.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.desc: Push alerts to your phone: outages, intrusions caught by the trap, UPS and security findings.

vulnScan.label: Weekly vulnerability scan
vulnScan.desc: Checks everything installed against the public vulnerability database once a week.

printing.label: Print server
printing.desc: Shares USB and network printers with your networks, including AirPrint for phones and tablets.

remote.label: Remote access
remote.desc: Use your home internet and filtering from anywhere, through Tailscale, WireGuard, OpenVPN or a proxy.

logwatch.label: AI log triage
logwatch.desc: A local language model reads the system log and alerts you to what matters. You pick and download a model (0.6–9 GB) to suit the router; it pauses itself when the router is busy.

elsewhere.label: QoS
elsewhere.desc: On/off and speeds on the QoS tab.

elsewhere.label: UPnP
elsewhere.desc: On/off and the block list on the UPnP tab.

elsewhere.label: Tailscale admin access
elsewhere.desc: Set in site.nix: it needs an auth key, and switching it off here could cut off remote admin.
